patterns.name: LLM Token Usage by Model & User
patterns.description: Calculates prompt and completion token consumption grouped by model name and developer identity.
patterns.cql: #repo = "genai-telemetry-logs" signal_type = "trace" | groupBy([model, user.email], function=([sum(gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens, as=total_prompt_tokens), sum(gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens, as=total_completion_tokens), count(as=call_count)])) | total_tokens := total_prompt_tokens + total_completion_tokens | sort(field=total_tokens, order=desc)

patterns.name: LLM Prompt Execution Latency Percentiles (P50, P90, P99)
patterns.description: Computes latency percentiles across AI model inference requests over time.
patterns.cql: #repo = "genai-telemetry-logs" signal_type = "trace" span_name = "chat.completions" | bucket(1h, field=[model], function=([percentile(duration_ms, percentiles=[50, 90, 99], as=[p50, p90, p99]), count(as=request_count)])) | sort(field=_bucket, order=desc)

patterns.name: Rate Limit (429) & Model Overloaded Error Spikes
patterns.description: Tracks spikes in model rate-limit exceptions and HTTP 429 / 503 error responses from upstream LLM providers.
patterns.cql: #repo = "genai-telemetry-logs" status_code = /^(429|500|503)$/ | groupBy([model, status_code, status_message], function=count(as=error_count)) | sort(field=error_count, order=desc)
